summary.intent: Run the GSD manager workflow to discuss, plan, and execute three UAT gap-closure phases (42 API unpin integrity, 43 FUSE write durability, 44 IPNS conflict handling) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone, then open a PR for Phase 42 and reconcile deferred planning docs.
summary.outcome: All three phases were executed: Phase 42 completed with PR #485 opened (owned-guarded unpin + quota fix + outbox drain worker + Grafana alert + backfill script), Phase 44 completed (three-way folder merge, 4-attempt retry, file CAS with loser-becomes-version, full caller sweep), Phase 43 code-complete but left in human_needed state awaiting 4 runtime UAT items. A ROADMAP.md corruption was repaired. A chore branch was started to reconcile stale BACKLOG items and promote 4 open security findings to tracked todos.

repo: Kubo v0.40 runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp) in staging — it keeps full public DHT participation and broadcasts provider records for every pinned CID, making CIDs effectively public identifiers even though blob contents are encrypted.

pnpm/jest double-dash gotcha: `pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X` fails because pnpm inserts its own `--`, causing jest to treat the pattern as a positional regex. Use `pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern='X'` instead.
gsd commit helper (`query commit`) returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when the commit landed — always verify with `git log`, never blind-retry.
Worktree cleanup (`cleanup-wave`) must be invoked from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree — helper resolves `repoRoot` from cwd, producing false `base_mismatch` errors otherwise.
`cleanup-wave` is not idempotent — already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on rerun. Write reduced manifests containing only remaining unmerged entries for partial re-runs.

Cross-package dist staleness: when `packages/sdk-core` source is updated but dist is not rebuilt, consuming packages (`sdk`, `web`) typecheck against stale types and produce misleading errors. Always `pnpm build` the dep package before running consumer `tsc`.
ROADMAP.md can be catastrophically truncated (658 → 25 lines) by GSD gap-planner edits that use a pattern matching phase section boundaries — verify line count with `wc -l` after planner runs.

`gsd health` W019 consolidates DEFERRED.md and REFACTORING.md into BACKLOG.md verbatim then removes the originals. Do not restore them; confirm the migration with `wc -l` before treating deletions as accidental.
`.planning/tmp/` is docs-generation scratch (verify JSONs, pre-edit backups) that should be gitignored. It is not tracked content.
The CI release-preview bot (`chore(release): set release targets`) auto-commits to feature branches after PR creation — fast-forward before adding subsequent commits to avoid divergence.

`nest build` has a side-effect of reformatting `openapi.json` with trailing newline/whitespace changes that show as 500+ line diffs. Restore with `git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json` after merging worktrees; the api-client regeneration commit is the canonical change.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 configured with `server` profile and swarm port 4001 exposed public (tcp+udp). The `server` profile only disables local-network discovery, not public DHT — so the node broadcasts provider records for every pinned CID to DHT crawlers.

Pre-Phase-42: `POST /ipfs/unpin` never read `req.user`; it passed whatever CID arrived straight to Kubo `pin/rm`. Any JWT holder (signup is open) could destroy another user's pinned content while quota stayed charged. Fixed by delegating to `vaultService.guardedUnpin(req.user.id, dto.cid)`.

`guardedUnpin` implements: `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid))` → transactional `pinned_cids` row delete + refcount → if last reference, insert `pending_unpins` → commit → Kubo `pin/rm` post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempts silently 2XX but emit `cipherbox_unpin_cross_user_attempts_total` metric.

Writable-share saves drop `prunedCids` without calling unpin — confirmed there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path through this code. The CIDs are logged but never freed. Noted as deferred improvement.

Had `spawn_journal.remove(&journal_entry_id)` inside the background upload thread — this creates an orphan window between upload success and the debounced parent-pointer publish. Fixed (CR-08): removal gated on per-file IPNS publish success; replay-on-mount is the authoritative cleanup path.

`updateFolderMetadataAndPublish` was not returning `publishedChildren` (the merged set at the moment of successful publish). All 14 call sites were using their stale pre-merge local children as base for the next write, reopening lost-update regressions one write later. Fixed by Phase 44 gap plan 44-06.

Previously called `batchPublishIpnsRecords` after `updateFileMetadata`. Phase 44 rewired this to consume the new CAS/internal-publish contract from `@cipherbox/sdk-core` which handles publish internally and returns `{ ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids }`.

workflow: On Claude Code, GSD plan and execute phases must run inline (not backgrounded) because a backgrounded agent cannot nest the pipeline's subagents — plan-checker, worktree-isolated executors, and verifier all become no-ops in a backgrounded context.
Worktree cruft (node_modules, .husky/_) must be physically removed before invoking cleanup-wave — untracked directories block the merge and abort the entire cleanup run.

1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git commands. If the agent returns an error, ask the user to restart 1Password. Never use `--no-gpg-sign` or `--no-verify`.
zsh multi-glob rm (`rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules`) aborts entirely if any glob expansion finds nothing — use single explicit paths.
When verifying file-at-rest encryption, prefer `xxd | head` over source-level analysis — the compile-time guarantees are not always honored at runtime (lesson from Phase 43 journal ciphertext audit).
Always answer technical questions in direct prose first before presenting option menus — re-presenting the same options without answering is confusing and forces the user to repeat themselves.

After any GSD planner or gap-planner agent run that touches ROADMAP.md, verify line count with `wc -l` immediately. Truncation to a phase-section boundary can silently discard the entire prior milestone history.

Session limit interruptions mid-worktree-execution leave agents running to completion — always spot-check the task output files (`/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/*.output`) for the interrupted agents before re-dispatching to avoid duplicate work and double-commits.
